claim: A message will be sent to your phone claiming to show that the Covid19 curve is flattening in India, But It will contain a malicious file
justification: The high-confidence, corroborated evidence from Fact-check A, including statements with confidence scores of 0.95 and 0.90, confirms that in October 2020, malicious WhatsApp messages claiming to show India's Covid-19 curve flattening were actively circulated and contained a malicious .apk file, as reported by authoritative sources like CERT-In and Reuters. This directly aligns with the claim, despite discounting low-confidence evidence such as the uncorroborated Kaspersky Labs detail.
